Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly identified the director of the 1972 film *Mirage*. It stated the director was "Edward Dmytryk," which is false. The correct director, as confirmed by subsequent searches within the same conversation (and visible in the search results provided in the same turn), is Armando Robles Godoy. Edward Dmytryk was a famous American director, but he did not direct the Peruvian film *Mirage* (1972). This initial factual error forced the rest of the conversation down an incorrect path before it was corrected in the second turn.
